scope: Qwen3.8 27B DFlash2 kernel follow-up before controller work. C1 release probes at depth0 only; no repeated full depth sweep.
retained: FP32 DeltaNet state remains in registers across verification rows for key/value dimensions128. Explicit fmaf(old_state, alpha, delta*key) preserves scalar decode rounding. Compiler memory barriers bound load hoisting; no VGPR spills.

Rejected-prefix replay groups recorded rows per layer, splitting at the16-row ring boundary and available scratch. A state-only kernel omits query/output work; conv history and recurrent transitions remain exact.
BF16 DFlash2 feature injection uses16 rows per launch, with1..8-row tails. FP32 activations and accumulation order are preserved for all three draft formats; trained draft blocks stay at8 rows.

The maintained production-template recurrence probe replaces the obsolete full-model replay executable. Prefill recurrence ablations move to tools/qwen27b; existing operator tests cover the new modes and are selected by check.py kernels.
The target quality fixture crosses the replay ring and commits5 rows. Optional quantization NLL uses each fixture's actual prefix offset and all8 forced continuation tokens.

operator_checks.coverage: FP32/BF16 state; scalar/batch8; full/state-only: all8 combinations preserve state and applicable output bits.
Exact BF16 GEMM widths1..8 and16 versus scalar decode, M65/K264 partial tiles; existing BLAS controls.

quality.trace_reference: All270 files byte-identical to the pinned-upstream-qualified traces, including intermediate tensors, logits, proposal probabilities and metadata. Reuses that qualification without rerunning PyTorch.

microbenchmark_scope: Four interleaved rounds. Recurrence rotates48 layer states (144MiB); GEMMs rotate at least128MiB of weights. Timings only count after exact output/state comparison.

release.workload: Short release A/B: C1, pp2048, tg128, depth0 only. One timed repetition after warmup per invocation; alternate release order across pairings. Candidate AR and every baseline/candidate speculative trace must equal prior qualified AR token IDs. Not a depth sweep or variance estimate.

baseline.workload: One diagnostic profile per target, Q4_K_M draft, cpp_ring_buffer chat, 128 tokens. TG begins at the first draft embedding; excludes initial prefill and draft injection. Executors are separated by HIP stream. Profile timings are not throughput estimates.

rejected: Initial resident-state arithmetic fused delta*key instead of state*alpha, changing output/state bits. Explicit original FMA restored every bit; unconstrained load hoisting then spilled32 VGPRs. Bounded hoisting removed spills.
Batch32 BF16 injection was slower than batch16 on the large feature projection; fewer waves or one output row per wave were also slower. Production retains only batch16.
limits: Single timed release repetition after warmup per pairing; this is not a variance estimate, full depth sweep or capability evaluation.
Greedy equivalence and exact state/logit/distribution preservation cover the tested inputs; original target checkpoint/conversion and MTP qualification remain separate work.
No controller changes, production environment switches or C>1 performance claims.
